routes.detail: Standalone SafeRoute, lazy page import at line 336; not the ordinary Layout route. Source mount declaration confirmed, actual mounted runtime not exercised.

purpose: Installation-level first-run setup checklist with account connection, vehicle sync, telemetry readiness, workspace persona configuration, resources, feature preview, refresh and skip/continue controls.
primaryGoal: Complete or deliberately defer the three existing setup anchors without confusing durable completion with a later live-service outage.

dataSources.name: useOnboardingStatus
dataSources.sourceOwner: internal/api/onboarding handler registered as onboardingHandler; handler implementation and persistence were not audited
dataSources.behavior: Query key ['onboarding','status']; AbortSignal forwarded; select normalizes partial payloads; staleTime 15000ms; retry 2; poll 30000ms only while incomplete by default. Page does not opt into pollAfterSetup. Completion prefers setup_complete, then is_complete, then hook legacy three-anchor AND.
dataSources.limits: Actual response, authorization, latency, Fleet API sync timing and durable persistence are unverified. Timing comments and router documentation are not runtime proof.

dataSources.name: useProductPreferences
dataSources.behavior: useSyncExternalStore; persona update merges into existing sanitized preferences. Local storage key teslasync:product-preferences:v1; blocked storage retains current-tab memory; storage events synchronize other tabs. Persona options owner/fleet_operator/analyst/administrator are presentation preferences, not permission changes.

dataSources.name: useOnboardingSkip
dataSources.behavior: Best-effort local flag teslasync:onboarding:skipped:v1, broadcast onboarding.skip.changed, storage-event synchronization. Skip sets the flag and navigates to /. No setup completion or OAuth mutation is performed by this page.
dataSources.integration: OnboardingGate honors skipped choice, allows onboarding/account/settings/login/public/watch routes, and avoids redirect on loading/error. Completion tracking remains gate-owned.

dataSources.name: data trust and display adapters
dataSources.behavior: deriveDataState retains refresh-failed/paused payloads, separates fatalError from refreshError. Feature status band passes null metrics when hasData is false and formats last telemetry time with existing date hook. No physical-unit conversion or workspace vehicle/range query is introduced.
dataSources.limits: Date formatter and operational-metric internals were not expanded; their usage was inspected, not their full implementation.

components.name: PageLayout
components.contract: Existing PageContainer adapter, full-width min-w-0 container, title/subtitle and inherited state/action APIs; standalone main retains viewport scroll ownership.

components.name: GlassPanel / Button / SectionTitle / Text
components.contract: Category imports; existing surfaces, typography and action variants. GlassPanel glow means hover-border tint in current implementation, not an actual luminous shadow.

components.name: IconBox
components.contract: color/size/className; bg/ring/text from neonColorMap. Shared subdued neutral treatment is currently missing.

components.name: PersonaSelect
components.contract: Typed persona value/onChange; explicit stable id, translated label/options/hint; wraps existing Select.

components.name: Stepper
components.contract: steps + renderCta; all rows visible; first incomplete row alone actionable, completed rows always completed, later incomplete rows pending; localized hidden status and aria-current=step.

components.name: OnboardingSetupStatusBand
components.contract: Account/count/telemetry/completion/loading/hasData/retained/lastTelemetryAt/error/onRetry; OperationalBrief with four StatMetric occurrences and contextual ProgressRing; QueryError is non-destructive.

components.name: OnboardingRuntimeHealthNotice
components.contract: Completed installations only; warning when authorization unavailable or telemetry stale; reconnect/status/alerts actions and stored-history explanation.

components.name: OnboardingResources / OnboardingFeaturePreview
components.contract: Three help links and privacy copy; four static informational preview cards, no live commands.

components.name: DataStateNotice / FadeIn
components.contract: Retained stale warning with preserveSeverity; existing FadeIn reduced-motion bridge. No alternate animation/state library is needed.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Refresh icons and callback pattern recur in vehicle-step CTA and footer Check again; icon boxes recur in page, resources and preview.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Continue reusing Button/IconBox; only extract a small feature helper if a later change actually requires coordinated behavior. Do not create another shared action or card system.

sourceStrategy.detail: h-screen/h-dvh standalone vertical scrolling, safe bottom padding, responsive gutters; actual mobile browser chrome/safe-area behavior unverified.
Persona block stacks until lg, then minmax columns; checklist/resources stack until xl three-column bento.
Preview grid 1 column, sm 2, lg 4; preserves all four cards.
Footer controls single-column full-width on small screens, wrapped flex at sm. wrapLabel preserves long action labels.
min-w-0/max-w-full/break-words/overflow-wrap protects list text; CTA width constrained.

issues.detail: Resource title is truncated rather than wrapped, risking visual loss of translated or enlarged labels; underlying accessible text remains present.
issues.fix: Allow multi-line resource titles and retain descriptions, target identity and 44px row minimum; check all required widths and text zoom.

sourceStrengths: Main landmark; localized page title and shared headings/text.
Stepper ol/li, aria-current=step, visually hidden localized done/current/pending status; state is not color alone.
Resource nav has accessible label, native links, localized external new-tab description and visible focus styling.
Runtime health notice uses role=status and aria-live=polite.
PersonaSelect receives explicit onboarding-workspace-profile id and label.
Stepper spinner motion-reduce:animate-none and FadeIn useMotionPreference are present; browser/OS behavior is unverified.

issues.detail: Telemetry Setup guide renders an anchor containing Button's native button. Nested interactive elements create ambiguous activation/focus semantics. Unlike the resources external links, this CTA supplies no localized new-tab announcement.
issues.fix: Render one native anchor with existing shared link chrome/BUTTON_BASE rather than a nested button; preserve href, new-tab rel, icon and label, and add localized new-tab description.

issues.detail: Step CTAs use size=sm, whose shared height/minimum is 36px. Runtime-health actions also use sm. These fall below the contract's default 44px mobile target; spacing exceptions and actual target geometry were not evaluated.
issues.fix: Use existing Button sizing/min-height capability at callsites for mobile target reachability; preserve desktop density, wrapping and disabled state. Verify keyboard and touch spacing before acceptance.

issues.detail: ArrowRight/RefreshCw/BookOpen/SkipForward and checklist Sparkles are supplied without explicit aria-hidden at several callsites; Button forwards supplied icons without universally hiding them. Actual assistive-technology naming impact is unverified.
issues.fix: Explicitly hide decorative action/checklist glyphs while retaining visible localized labels and all controls.

states.loading: SetupStatusBand loading={!hasData && isLoading}; summary values null without data. Checklist/resources/profile/preview/footer remain reachable, no whole-page loading gate.
states.empty: A fresh valid response with zero vehicles is a normal incomplete setup state. Stepper's missing-list EmptyState is defensive; page always supplies three steps.
states.error: fatalError is passed only to summary QueryError with refetch retry; other sections/actions remain. Retained refresh failure uses stale notice and retained summary.
states.stale: deriveDataState marks retained errored/paused responses stale. Page retains source data and sets retained=true; runtime telemetry stale is separately modeled.
states.offline: Retained paused query yields generic stale notice; no-data paused query remains initial. Offline-specific explanation is not wired.
states.complete: setup_complete/is_complete keeps all three step rows completed; continue replaces skip. Completed setup with expired account/stale telemetry remains complete and shows separate recovery notice.
states.unknown: Telemetry unknown is not offline. Summary raw metrics are null when !hasData, but checklist booleans/count default to false/zero and show the account CTA before source resolution.

issues.detail: Without a response, checklist still appears definitively incomplete with a current account-connect CTA. The summary correctly marks values unknown. Page ignores isRefreshBlocked/refreshError detail, so initial offline and retained offline are not distinguished in the page presentation.
issues.fix: Add a scoped unknown/loading/offline explanatory affordance using existing data-trust and feedback contracts, without hiding checklist or disabling intentional setup/navigation. Preserve pessimistic hook/gate normalization and source cache behavior.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-015 / mission no neon and limited visual intensity
visualIssues.detail: Non-actionable preview cards opt into hover elevation and cyan glow prop. Current GlassPanel maps this to hover:border-cyan-400/40, not a luminous shadow. Combined with four colored IconBoxes, previews compete with the actionable checklist.
visualIssues.fix: Keep all four informational cards/copy/list semantics; remove action-like colored hover emphasis and use neutral shared panel treatment.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / mission no fluorescent default language
visualIssues.detail: Page, resources and preview all reuse IconBox, which applies bg-neon-*/10 and ring-neon-*/20 via neonColorMap. Text is toned-down 300-level, not pure white; IconBox does not apply the map's glow property. Decorative multi-hue accents are source-confirmed, actual saturation/contrast is unmeasured.
visualIssues.fix: Shared owner should provide a restrained neutral/semantic appearance on the existing IconBox API; adopt for decorative icons without modifying persisted theme names or meaningful statuses.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 / MDC-020 theme-aware surface and focus
visualIssues.detail: Resource links use fixed-white 2%/4% fills and fixed cyan hover border/focus ring. This is white surface decoration, not pure-white text; theme composition is not runtime verified.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing control/surface/focus tokens for link rows; preserve native link affordance, row size, localized help and privacy note.

visualIssues.detail: ProgressRing uses fixed #22d3ee incomplete cyan and #10b981 completion green; it does not follow saved theme accent. Stepper repeats cyan/emerald colored borders/backgrounds. These are meaningful state hues, not reasons to remove progress.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing gaugeTone/theme variables through ProgressRing's color prop and coordinated subdued semantic step styles; retain raw completed count, 3-step total, labels and glyph/status distinctions.

architectureIssues.detail: Page correctly uses deriveDataState/fatalError but maps every retained degradation to a generic stale notice and never forwards busy/loading/query state to PageLayout. Shared page load announcements therefore are not connected to this query.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse existing PageLayout busy/query or localized scoped announcements as appropriate without supplying loading in a way that hides all interactive content. Preserve one query key, retained data and independent telemetry health.

priority.rationale: Functionally rich and already decomposed; prioritize nested CTA semantics and truthful unknown/offline presentation, then calm decorative accents and mobile target/long-label QA. No evidence warrants replacing step progression, account configuration or setup routing.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Restrained appearance on existing IconBox
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Current color API always selects neonColorMap backgrounds/rings; this page's repeated decorative use needs a neutral treatment without duplicating an icon-container implementation.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Consider an additive typed appearance='neutral'|'semantic' option coordinated with the design owner, preserving existing color/size/default behavior and shared import paths. This is a proposal, not an accepted or implemented API.
requiredSharedChanges.ownerContract: Neutral foreground/surface/border tokens; semantic hues only when state meaning exists; sm/md/lg and className retained; no new theme or palette store; decorative icons retain aria-hidden at caller.
propsVariantsStates: existing color and size props unchanged
non-interactive decorative container; no new hover/click behavior
requiredSharedChanges.limits: These are independently rendered consumers inside one assigned feature, not proof of independent production-feature demand. Broader inventory/deduplication remains orchestrator-owned; no new composite is requested.

competingImplementations.detail: Gate comments refer to an unmounted OnboardingWizard, but that file/mount graph was not inspected; cannot certify competing wizard absence. Audited page is the App.tsx /onboarding route.
competingImplementations.decision: Do not restore or build another wizard. Keep this page's existing Stepper and gate/completion responsibilities.

competingImplementations.detail: PageLayout category export already points to layout-reference implementation; reuse it, not a new onboarding layout system.
competingImplementations.decision: Existing primitives/domain decomposition are canonical for this scope.

preservation.sectionCountMeaning: Seven named functional blocks, including the conditional runtime health notice; stale notice is an additional source-state affordance, not a business section.
preservation.countLimits: Declaration counts are not mounted counts: preview GlassPanel maps four items; error panel and recovery notice are conditional. Shared OperationalBrief/PageContainer internals are not counted as business sections.

actions.name: Connect Tesla account
actions.behavior: Current account step navigates /tesla-account; OAuth/configuration remain destination-owned.

actions.name: Vehicle Refresh
actions.behavior: Current vehicle step refetches; disabled while isFetching and localized Checking label.

actions.name: Telemetry Setup guide
actions.behavior: Current telemetry step opens /docs/fleet-telemetry-setup in new tab with noopener/noreferrer.

actions.name: Choose primary use
actions.behavior: Update persona only; preserve stored preference schema, defaults and other values.

actions.name: Summary retry
actions.behavior: Fatal source error refetch; no authentication submission.

actions.name: Runtime recovery
actions.behavior: Conditional reconnect /tesla-account, stale telemetry /system-status, recovery notice /notifications/channels.

actions.name: Check again
actions.behavior: Manual refetch, disabled during isFetching, retains spin indication.

actions.name: Skip for now
actions.behavior: Incomplete only; local skip and navigate /; preserve localized explanatory title.

actions.name: Continue to dashboard
actions.behavior: Complete only; navigate /, not a new saved landing-page behavior.

dataBehavior: Only the first incomplete step shows its CTA; completed rows and pending rows remain visible.
Durable setupComplete overrides individual degraded anchors for checklist/progress completion, not the live health descriptions.
Keep normalized pessimistic gate behavior, query key, select, retry/stale policy, cancellation and incomplete-only 30s polling.
Keep source defaults and schema compatibility; any unknown-state presentation improvement must not change hook normalization or routing policy.
Retain fatal-vs-refresh error distinction, cached data, nullable summary measurements, telemetry timestamp/source explanations and independent live health warning.
No duplicate workspace range/vehicle selectors; first-run installation page remains usable without vehicles or telemetry.
Preserve localized setup timing/privacy/help copy, but treat the promises as existing UI copy, not verified backend/privacy capabilities.
No source data, user settings, exports, chart series or configuration submissions may be invented; this page currently has no export or chart actions.
preservation.scope: Audit only; no source modernization or section removal occurred.

governingDocs.detail: Phase 0 JSON schema, exclusive report/heartbeat ownership and source-only limits.
Reuse current architecture; MDC-010 through MDC-047 cover tokens, state trust, preservation, accessibility, responsiveness and persistence.
Sections 0/1 preserve capabilities and audit before redesign; sections 5–9 visual restraint, 15/16 responsiveness, 22–25 states, 30/31 accessibility/motion and 33 data separation were inspected.

evidenceLimits.runtime: NOT EXERCISED; no browser navigation, screenshots, live API calls, OAuth/account connection, preference/skip action or setup submission.
evidenceLimits.visual: Source classes and composition only; neon/glow/saturation/fixed-white findings are not screenshot or measured-contrast acceptance. No pure-white text or actual luminous panel glow was found in the audited page source.
evidenceLimits.backend: Only matching router registration/comments were inspected. Handler, database durability, permissions, Fleet API behavior, data-flow timing and privacy claims remain unverified.
evidenceLimits.dependencyScope: Only mounted route declaration and page-specific UI/data dependencies expanded; no whole-app audit or unrelated routes. Select, operational formatting, date formatting and shared layout transitive internals were not fully traced.
evidenceLimits.tests: No TypeScript, lint, build, tests or full audit script executed. The loaded audit script includes project-wide tsc, conflicting with this explicitly source-only bounded assignment; static page checks were run directly instead.
evidenceLimits.staticCheckMethod: PowerShell Get-Content -Raw of the assigned page and regex counts for raw control tags, style={, direct chart/map/motion library imports, relative old API imports, text-neon-, text-white, GlassPanel and ChartContainer declarations; exit 0. Counts exclude transitive dependencies and are not a clean whole-feature certificate.

reportValidation.command: Get-Content docs\frontend-audits\audit-page-152.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; verify all 19 required keys, Test-Path for filesRead, and Get-FileHash web\src\features\onboarding\pages\OnboardingPage.tsx -Algorithm SHA256 against preservation.sourceSha256
reportValidation.meaning: Valid report and unchanged page source only, not application runtime acceptance.

evidenceLimits.commandFailures: One initial PowerShell citation/count command had a quoting ParserError (exit 1), performed no reads/writes, and was corrected; successful bounded counts were subsequently captured.
evidenceLimits.sourceSnapshot: Page SHA-256 and line counts taken from current bytes without Git. Concurrent shared source may evolve; these citations describe this audit snapshot.
